title: PrivacyRTBFRequest - Data API
description: Represents a Right to Be Forgotten Request made in Privacy Center. This object is available in API version 59.0 and later.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: The description of the customer’s Right to Be Forgotten request.

JobRecord.description: The record ID that is processed by the Right to Be Forgotten request.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the Right to Be Forgotten request.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the account associated with this customer. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PolicyNameId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PolicyNameId.description: The name of the Right to Be Forgotten policy applied to this request. This field is a relationship field.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: Represents the status of the request. Possible values are: Cancelled Complete Error Pending Scheduled

special_access_rules:

- **PrivacyRTBFRequestOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **PrivacyRTBFRequestShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
